ARKhives 8.19.9 — Desktop lesson canvas

- Rebuild the video and document workspace around the approved visual reference: a narrow navigation rail, course breadcrumb, one workspace toolbar, and two flat panes that fill the available desktop window.
- Remove the small boxed-video limit and the duplicate app toolbar above ONLYOFFICE. Preserve the native ribbon and vendor notices.
- Move notebook tabs, creating/renaming notebooks, Word/ONLYOFFICE selection, revisions, recovery, export, and advanced editor controls into the Notebooks drawer. Keep course navigation available in a Sources drawer.
- Keep playback and capture controls together, with independently scrolling chapters/transcript and source documents. Default new balanced layouts to 42% lesson / 58% writing; preserve existing per-source preferences.
- Preserve the mounted video and editor when changing focus, swapping panes, resizing, or floating the video. Fix an inactive video page covering the document workspace and remove a legacy maximum-width limit.
- Isolate viewport navigation from legacy page animations so normal motion cannot offset the brand/navigation bars or block toolbar clicks. Keep motion available inside the workspace.
- Add a notebook page/zoom footer and coordinate native editor keyboard focus with workspace dialogs. Keep ARKbot in the navigation rail rather than over the notebook.
- Retain existing notebook contents, source links, local recovery, AI preview-before-insertion, question banks, and personal study progress.

Validation: 28 focused editor/layout tests; real bundled ONLYOFFICE browser acceptance at 1152, 1440, 1588, and 1920 pixels with normal and reduced motion; actual video decoding, unobscured viewport navigation, drawer keyboard input, access to closed notebooks alongside open tabs, notebook save and AI insertion, focus/swap/floating modes, and the real video-to-document tab. Aborted saves and account changes cannot open a hidden source editor. The browser acceptance uses synthetic lesson/account data and a mocked AI provider; it does not exercise a paid live AI request.
